sentences.japanese: 奥さんの尻にしかれている。
sentences.english: His wife leads him by the nose.

sentences.japanese: やめなさい、お尻をぶちますよ。
sentences.english: Stop that, or I'll fix your wagon.

sentences.japanese: トムってしっかり奥さんの尻に敷かれているのね。
sentences.english: Tom's wife keeps him on such a short rope.

sentences.japanese: スーはお尻が大きいが、気にしていない。
sentences.english: Sue has a big bottom, but she doesn't care.

sentences.japanese: あの夫婦は共かせぎしている。だが亭主の給料のほうが女房の給料よりも低い。亭主が女房の尻にしかれるのも当然だ。
sentences.english: He and his wife both work and his salary is lower than hers, so no wonder he is a hen-pecked husband.
